key_moments: Australia won 5-4 on penalties after 120 minutes of scoreless play
Egypt missed the decisive fifth penalty kick
Australia goalkeeper made two crucial saves during the shootout

standout_performers.reason: Kept a clean sheet and secured the shootout victory
Constant threat on the counter-attack throughout the match

matches.tactical_summary: Australia maintained a disciplined low block to neutralize Egypt's pace, while Egypt struggled to break down the compact defensive structure. The match remained a tactical stalemate as both sides prioritized defensive security over offensive risks.

narrative: The Round of 16 opened with a grueling tactical battle that tested the nerves of both nations. Australia's resilience under pressure ultimately proved the difference in a high-stakes penalty shootout.
qf_notes: Australia advances to the Quarterfinals with no reported suspensions, though fatigue will be a major concern following 120 minutes of play.
